reopened_reason: RS094 isolates one sufficient individual star link.

new_assertions.body: RS094 freezes all16 individual capacity-star edge subsets. Exactly masks8–15 pass. The unique minimal subset is capacity versus positive-depth owner1 sign correlation, pooled rank342, with individual ranks71/260/13. Full-star rank350 reconstructs.

Given T_i and |N_i|, the zero/nonzero status of sign(N_C)*sign(N_P1) is known. The remaining correlation information is one Boolean per pair. This does not establish a one-bit scalar correction: the qualified assembly still uses one-hot sorted triangle labels.

Owner1 denotes the fixed r1 residual source channel, not automatically the mover or opponent. The selected link has bounded grid minimality only; no universal player preference or closed scalar formula follows.

A pair relation can be informationally one bit while its association to3 different marginal pair records remains load-bearing. Replacing paired labels with a symmetric aggregate is a new structural hypothesis and needs its own qualification.
